items.docs: Here dish_type is also normalized. All tailing digits and spaces get removed from dish_type. For example Tagesgericht 1 -> Tagesgericht and Aktionsessen 6 -> Aktionsessen. Also ignores all menus older than one day. This results in this file being usually half the size of the all.json file. This is currently deprecated, and only supported in the german language.
